title: Care Farming (치유농업)
image_caption: Therapeutic Horticultural Garden for Care Farming
description: Therapeutic Care Farming & Barrier-Free CEA Engineering: clinical horticultural therapy, ergonomic glasshouse design, and sensory steering.
overview: Care Farming (치유농업) is the therapeutic use of farming practices—including plant cultivation, animal care, and rural landscapes—to provide social, clinical, educational, or rehabilitative services. By merging agriculture with healthcare, it creates sustainable social enterprises that improve community well-being while utilizing the natural therapeutic benefits of nature. In high-tech Controlled Environment Agriculture (CEA), care farming utilizes barrier-free automation to expand accessibility. From an architectural and environmental systems engineering perspective, modern Care Farming facilities must bridge clinical rehabilitation ergonomics with high-precision horticultural automation. Standard commercial production glasshouses prioritize extreme crop steering—such as elevated daytime temperatures (26–28°C), high vapor pressure deficits, and narrow elevated pipe-rail aisles—which pose thermal strain and mobility hazards for elderly dementia patients, neurodivergent youth, and physical rehabilitation participants. Consequently, barrier-free therapeutic glasshouses are engineered around ISO 7730 Predicted Mean Vote (PMV) human thermal comfort envelopes (20.0–22.5°C, relative humidity 50–65%, VPD 0.65–0.85 kPa), zero-threshold non-slip flooring with >= 150 cm wheelchair turning radii, and height-adjustable mobile hydroponic NFT/substrate benches (75–85 cm working height). By automating root-zone fertigation dosing, UV-C water sanitation, and glare-free diffused supplemental LED lighting (CRI > 92), systems engineers empower clinical horticultural therapists to focus entirely on multisensory olfactory, tactile, and cognitive engagement while maintaining commercial-grade phytosanitary safety.

climate_strategy.strategy: Pioneered the integration of care farms into the national health insurance system (WMO/Wlz). Over 1,200 active care farms provide day services for elderly dementia patients, youth with autism, and recovering addicts. Farms combine commercial horticulture with structured social support. Facility SCADA controllers continuously cross-reference aspirated PT1000 dry-bulb/wet-bulb psychrometers with infrared radiometric leaf-surface temperature sensors to calculate real-time leaf-to-air VPD rather than relying solely on ambient air relative humidity. Automated proportional-integral-derivative (PID) loops modulate roof vent apertures, energy-saving aluminized screens, and variable-speed circulation fans to keep canopy boundary-layer resistance below 60 s m⁻¹ and prevent microclimatic stratification across Care Farming / Social Farming production zones.
climate_strategy.tech_level: High (Accessible glasshouses, occupational therapy equipment, dairy farms)

crop_steering.intro: Rather than commercial crop steering (maximizing yield), Care Farming utilizes 'Therapeutic Environment Steering' to optimize user safety, sensory engagement, and ease of participation. Precision steering in Care Farming (치유농업) requires coordinating diurnal temperature differentials (DIF), canopy-level Vapor Pressure Deficit (VPD), spectral photon ratios, and substrate dry-back percentages (Δθv) so that assimilate partitioning between structural vegetative sinks and generative or secondary metabolic sinks remains in thermodynamic equilibrium.

vegetative_triggers.temperature_dif: Thermal comfort targets (20-22°C year-round). Avoid extreme DIF that causes worker fatigue or cold drafts.
vegetative_triggers.vpd_target: 0.6 - 0.8 kPa (Maintains comfortable indoor air humidity for patients and elderly).
vegetative_triggers.irrigation: Elevated gutter heights (75-85cm) for wheelchair accessibility. Focus on simple, drip-irrigated grow bags for easy planting.

generative_triggers.temperature_dif: Avoid. Keep climate stable to ensure barrier-free activities without thermal shock or heat stress.
generative_triggers.vpd_target: Avoid high VPD (low humidity) which dries out throat passages and worsens dry eye symptoms in elderly users.
generative_triggers.irrigation: Incorporate sensory irrigation tasks (e.g., hand-watering herbs) using lightweight cans to build fine motor skills.

fertigation.intro: Fertigation systems in Care Farming prioritize safety, non-toxicity, and user interaction over maximize crop yield. Electrochemical balance in the rhizosphere requires strict maintenance of electroneutrality between macronutrient cations (K⁺, Ca²⁺, Mg²⁺, NH₄⁺) and anions (NO₃⁻, H₂PO₄⁻, SO₄²⁻), preventing competitive transporter antagonism and stabilizing root-zone pH within the optimal 5.6–6.2 bioavailability window.
fertigation.vegetative_phase: Organic-based, low-concentration liquid fertilizers to prevent chemical burns if handled by patients. Maintain strict hygiene protocols to avoid mold growth in media. Monitor return drainage volume (20–30% leach fraction in substrate culture) and inline dissolved oxygen saturation (> 8.2 mg L⁻¹ at 20.0°C) to sustain root mitochondrial ATP synthesis and plasma membrane H⁺-ATPase proton-pumping kinetics. Chelated micronutrients (Fe-EDDHA/DTPA 35–55 µM, Mn 10 µM, Zn 5 µM, B 35 µM, Cu 1.0 µM, Mo 0.8 µM) must be dosed proportionally to prevent latent enzymatic cofactor deficiencies.
fertigation.generative_phase: Focus on high-aromatic herb nutrition (lavender, mint, rosemary) to maximize essential oil production, enhancing sensory olfactory stimulation during therapeutic sessions. Monitor return drainage volume (20–30% leach fraction in substrate culture) and inline dissolved oxygen saturation (> 8.2 mg L⁻¹ at 20.0°C) to sustain root mitochondrial ATP synthesis and plasma membrane H⁺-ATPase proton-pumping kinetics. Chelated micronutrients (Fe-EDDHA/DTPA 35–55 µM, Mn 10 µM, Zn 5 µM, B 35 µM, Cu 1.0 µM, Mo 0.8 µM) must be dosed proportionally to prevent latent enzymatic cofactor deficiencies.

engineering_deep_dive.title: Thermodynamic, Mass-Transfer & Bioenergetic Engineering Analysis: Care Farming (치유농업)
paragraphs: In high-precision Controlled Environment Agriculture (CEA), optimizing Care Farming (치유농업) (Care Farming / Social Farming) requires solving the coupled energy and mass balance across the soil-plant-atmosphere continuum (SPAC). At the canopy boundary layer, net radiative energy absorption (R_n)—comprising solar shortwave transmission and supplemental solid-state LED photon flux—is partitioned between sensible heat convection (H) and latent heat of transpiration (λE) according to the Penman-Monteith equation. When aerodynamic boundary-layer resistance (r_b = δ / D_v, where δ is the laminar sub-layer thickness and D_v is molecular diffusivity) is excessive due to stagnant horizontal airflow (< 0.15 m s⁻¹), leaf surface temperature (T_leaf) rises 1.5°C to 3.2°C above ambient dry-bulb air temperature (T_air). This thermal decoupling exponentially inflates the leaf-to-air Vapor Pressure Deficit (VPD_leaf = e_sat(T_leaf) − e_air), triggering abscisic acid (ABA) and hydraulic guard-cell closure (increasing stomatal resistance r_s > 450 s m⁻¹). Once stomata constrict, intercellular CO₂ concentration (C_i) plummets while transpirational xylem mass flow of non-phloem-mobile calcium (Ca²⁺) and boron (B) to rapidly dividing meristems stalls.

Simultaneously, within the rhizosphere and cellular metabolic network (Social Care & Health (사회복지 및 보건) — Green Care (그린케어)), nutrient ion uptake is governed by active electrochemical proton gradients generated by root plasma membrane H⁺-ATPase (EC 7.1.2.1). Each mole of nitrate (NO₃⁻) symported across the root epidermis requires co-transport of two protons (2H⁺) and sustained mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation (ATP synthesis), which in turn obeys Michaelis-Menten kinetics with respect to dissolved oxygen concentration (K_m ≈ 0.8–1.2 mg O₂ L⁻¹, with functional saturation requiring DO > 8.0 mg L⁻¹ at 20°C). By integrating canopy psychrometric enthalpy balances with root-zone Nernst-Planck ion diffusion and metabolic flux control, CEA systems engineers prevent both aerial photoinhibition and rhizosphere hypoxia, achieving deterministic yield stability and premium phytochemical density.

sensor_control_protocol.title: Industrial Sensor Telemetry, PLC Control Architecture & Actuator Safeguards
paragraphs: Commercial deployment of the Care Farming (치유농업) engineering protocol relies on a three-tier distributed supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) architecture. Field-level sensing must avoid unshielded wall-mounted temperature/humidity probes; instead, deploy aspirated PT1000 psychrometer boxes positioned at the active apical canopy plane alongside narrow-field-of-view (15°) Apogee or Heitronics infrared radiometers measuring true leaf surface temperature (T_leaf ± 0.2°C). Photosynthetically Active Radiation (PAR, 400–700 nm) and extended ePAR (400–750 nm including Far-Red) are integrated at 10-second intervals via cosine-corrected quantum sensors to compute real-time accumulated Daily Light Integral (DLI) and dynamically modulate LED PWM dimming or supplemental lighting hours.

In the fertigation loop, redundant dual-junction glass pH electrodes, 4-ring toroidal conductivity (EC) cells, and optical luminescence Dissolved Oxygen (DO) transmitters continuously audit both injection supply headers and return drainage troughs. Frequency-Domain Reflectometry (FDR) dielectric slab sensors monitor volumetric water content (θ_v, % VWC), pore-water electrical conductivity (EC_p), and root-zone temperature (RZT). Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs) enforce hard hardware interlocks: if supply EC deviates by more than ±0.25 dS m⁻¹ from setpoint, or if supply pH drops below 5.2, Venturi dosing valves automatically latch into bypass recirculation mode and trigger a high-priority operator alert.

faq_list.question: How does leaf temperature (T_leaf) vs. air temperature (T_air) affect VPD calculation in Care Farming (치유농업)?
faq_list.answer: Standard ambient VPD calculations assume T_leaf equals T_air, which introduces a 15–35% error in Care Farming (치유농업) canopies. Under high solar radiation or HPS lighting, T_leaf exceeds T_air by +1.5°C to +3.0°C, raising internal leaf saturation vapor pressure (e_sat) and driving true leaf-to-air VPD much higher than wall sensors indicate. Conversely, under high-efficiency LED lighting without thermal IR radiation, high transpiration cools T_leaf 0.8°C to 1.5°C below T_air. Always compute VPD using an infrared leaf radiometer to prevent hidden stomatal closure or nocturnal condensation.

faq_list.question: What is the optimal root-zone dissolved oxygen (DO) and temperature threshold to prevent root hypoxia in Care Farming / Social Farming?
faq_list.answer: In hydroponic and substrate systems for Care Farming / Social Farming, nutrient solution temperature should be stabilized between 18.0°C and 21.0°C with dissolved oxygen maintained at 8.2 to 10.5 mg L⁻¹ (> 95% saturation, or supersaturated via Venturi/nanobubble injection). Above 23.0°C, Henry's Law oxygen solubility drops while root mitochondrial respiration doubles per 10°C (Q₁₀ ≈ 2.1), rapidly depleting boundary-layer O₂ below 4.0 mg L⁻¹, halting active Ca²⁺/NO₃⁻ uptake, and inviting opportunistic Pythium and Phytophthora zoospore infection.

faq_list.question: How should EC and irrigation dry-back (ΔVWC) be adjusted when transitioning Care Farming (치유농업) from vegetative to generative steering?
faq_list.answer: To steer Care Farming (치유농업) vegetatively, initiate irrigation 30–45 minutes after sunrise using small shot volumes (2–3% of substrate volume) at high frequency to hold volumetric water content (VWC) stable with minimal overnight dry-back (6–8%) and moderate EC. To steer generatively or induce phytochemical accumulation, delay the first morning irrigation until 90–120 minutes after sunrise, increase individual shot volume (4–6% VWC) at lower frequency, enforce a controlled overnight dry-back of 12–16% VWC, and elevate root-zone EC by +0.5 to +1.2 dS m⁻¹ while increasing potassium and sulfate ratios.
